down_button.tip: Jump to the end of the code.
down_button.what: Scrolls the code view to the last line.
examples: Open the build log and click it to see the last lines first.
Jump to the error at the end of a long build log.

close_btn.what: Closes the code viewer. Unsaved edits are lost.
examples: Click it after reading the log.
Close after copying the function you needed.

explorer.tip: Show the file in the Windows explorer.
explorer.what: Opens the folder that holds this code file, with the file selected.
examples: Click it to copy the log file and send it with a bug report.
Open the folder to diff two versions of a block file.
explorer.details: Windows only: explorer /select on the code file path.
